meta.title: Privacy – {name}
meta.description: Privacy on the {name} website: no cookies, no trackers, and nothing you type is sent.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: This site uses no cookies and no trackers.

items.title: No cookies, no trackers
items.text: This site doesn't count visitors and doesn't load anything from other sites, fonts included.

items.title: Hosting
items.text: This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub receives technical data when you open a page, such as your IP address. It keeps that data in its own security logs. I don't have access to them.

items.title: Appearance
items.text: If you choose the light or the dark appearance, your browser keeps this choice on your device. It is not sent anywhere.

items.title: The trial
items.text: What you type in the trial stays in the page, along with the names of the files you add. Nothing is sent or kept: it's gone when you close or reload the page. The files themselves are never read.

items.title: Contacting me
items.text: There's no form on this site and no email address to write to. If you message me on LinkedIn, I only use your details to answer you.

items.title: New versions
items.text: To hear about new versions, watch the repository on GitHub or follow the RSS feed. Neither gives me your email address.

items.title: The tool itself
items.text: This page only covers this website. What you enter in {name} stays on the hosting you choose: your own server, or managed hosting.

items.title: Your rights
items.text: To see, correct, or delete what you sent me, just ask me.
